body: Chip two shipped. PR https://github.com/SatanshuMishra/logbook/pull/205, branch test/pin-close-pointer-release-semantics, commit 761ebb35 off b4ca0b89, subject "test: pin close_thread pointer release order and id-only rule".U+000AU+000ATwo cases added to test/spawn/close.test.ts. close.a-refused-closure-leaves-the-pointer-so-park-can-still-record drives a close refused because the closure detail exceeds the session-log cap once escaped, then asserts the pointer survives and a following park_thread carrying an outcome succeeds. close.releases-a-pointer-held-by-a-foreign-session writes a pointer whose session_id this server process never held, closes the named thread, and asserts the file is gone.U+000AU+000AMutation results: release moved to the top of the handler turns the refused-close case red at exit 1; a session_id equality check added to releasePointerIfOwned turns the foreign-session case red with the pointer surviving where null was expected. Both load-bearing.U+000AU+000AONE HONEST GAP, reported by the lead rather than hidden. Moving the release to sit immediately above the ledger commit leaves the refused-close case GREEN, because reaching the code between the last refusal check and the commit requires not being refused, so no refused input can execute a release placed there. Only a failure of the commit itself exercises that position. The asymmetry points the wrong way: a refactor is likelier to nudge the release one line up than to hoist it to the top of the handler, so the test currently guards the unlikely mistake and misses the likely one. Follow-up lead dispatched to determine whether a commit failure can be forced deterministically, with an explicit instruction to report an honest gap rather than manufacture one with a sleep or a race, and to stop rather than add a test seam to production code.U+000AU+000AA mid-course correction worth keeping. The first fixture used 2000 newline characters, which trim to empty and therefore tripped the abandon-reason check, the earliest return in the handler and four statements before the intended one. The case was passing for the wrong reason and guarded almost none of the window. A code-reviewer caught it as HIGH; switching to a character that is escaped but is not whitespace moved the refusal to the last check before the commit.U+000AU+000ACorrects my brief: continuity-rule-census.test.ts does NOT govern tool description text. It scans docs/rules/continuity-ledger.md and checks that every backticked tool-shaped identifier resolves to a registered tool. The gates that do bind the description are the 2048-byte budget, the 200-byte lead-sentence ceiling and the published-claims census; the new sentence measures 748 and 90 and preserves both required phrases.U+000AU+000Aclose_thread.ts:97 gained one sentence: "Closing also releases the record of what is being worked, but only when that record names the thread being closed." Commit typed test: rather than fix: because no control flow moved, and fix: would advertise a behavioural change a reviewer would look for and not find.U+000AU+000AReceipts: npm test exit 0 at 820 tests 0 failures across two verifier runs, typecheck exit 0, close.test.ts 6 of 6 passing. The concurrent.distinct-ids race did not fire.U+000AU+000ASecond agent this session to flag the bypass-permissions system reminder as a possible injection. It is a genuine harness setting with benign content; briefed forward not to raise it a third time.
